bhojpuri_reject_caveat: langdetect has no 'bho' label, so it cannot itself catch Bhojpuri text misclassified as Hindi (they share vocabulary and script). dropped_language.likely_bhojpuri is an active reject filter (see clean_lib.marker_counts / language_ok below), not just a count: any document where Bhojpuri lexical markers (बा/बाटे/बाड़ें/एगो/गइल/भइल/कइल/etc., >=2 hits) outnumber Hindi markers (है/हैं/एक/गया/हुआ/किया/etc.) is dropped before reaching data/cleaned/. This is a coarse lexical heuristic, not a language model, so it will not catch every case - documented as a known limitation, not a solved problem.
